text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur says she wants to go to an

underground race as we're making our
way back
from a day out, so I decide to
join her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm outta here. And just so we're clear,
that was
all the help I'm giving you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait for m—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just leave me alone, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put her in a bad mood last time we
went out, so
I'm hoping I can make
myself more useful today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to waste looking after
you, so
just keep your trap shut if you're
gonna insist on
hanging around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks dead serious, so I do as
bidden and
keep quiet so as not to
bother her. I figure she
likely just wants
to collect data. We head to the
venue,
where...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look who we've got here. Come all the
way out
here to collect data, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't see what business it is of yours.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no need to get riled up. It's just
rare to see
someone from the academy
here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'd say you're in luck. There's
some
decent talent in today's line—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't care.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I said I don't care. Most of the people
here don't
have proper form, so I've got
no use for their
data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Collecting meaningless data is no
different than
collecting trash. I'm not
looking to waste my time
with anything
so inefficient.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...So that's the kind of person you are,
huh? You
can't recognize talent unless
it's got an official
seal of approval on it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell'd you just say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the growing tension in the air, I
interrupt.
Although Air Shakur is often
misunderstood, she's
never been
someone who looks down on others.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.
choice_data_list: シャカールには別の目的があるんだと思うよ
choice_data_list_en: I think Shakur has another objective in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And if either of you want to hear it, then
pipe
down for a minute. The race is
starting.

text_block_list.name: Runners
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAH!
HYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race must be a special one, because
the
cheers at the venue are almost wild
in their
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah. Yeah, that's good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All right. Here's the reason I came today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur does something with her
computer,
and it begins to emit a sharp
sound.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is that... the sound of the crowd just now
in the
background of the song?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The song, likely still incomplete,
features a
sample she just recorded
during the race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was something missing
with this
track, and then I thought of this
place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It needed a feeling of
longing—something crude
but intense.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see what you mean. Sure enough, it's
not easy to
find that kind of pure
passion in a more formal
environment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I liked what I heard. Looks
like
you've got at least one person
looking forward to
hearing the finished
track. Now, I'll take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, high and mighty to the end. Thanks
for
wasting my time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, high and mighty to the end. Thanks
for
wasting my time.

text_block_list.text:
Eh, it came out fine. It was something to
do, at
least.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I did what I came to do, so I'm
heading
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing she doesn't want to talk
about it, but
today, I've learned how
stoically she approaches
her music.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did. I just don't like people
up in my
business.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be very efficient to come
here just for
fun, now would it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Shakur outsmart Sirius Symboli
once again
reminds me just how
formidable she really is.
